title: The Rocketeer
method: Distinct on-screen gunfire casualties are counted conservatively, with the dead ledge commando corroborated in the shooting screenplay. This is an editorial lower bound, not a dialogue-reported exact total.

ledger.basis: Three distinct commandos fall under the first forecourt burst. Additional partly obscured figures are excluded.
A separately framed commando by the lamp is struck and falls.
Two commandos by the wall are struck and fall. The third figure crossing the shot is not counted.
The foreground gunman is struck and falls. The running background figure is excluded.

ledger.reference: 00:15–00:21; screenplay scene 120, printed p. 106 / PDF page 121
ledger.basis: The commando dragged over the ledge with Cliff is explicitly dead when Cliff retrieves his pistol in the following screenplay action. Cliff survives and is excluded.

excluded_from_observatory_count.reason: They survive; participation in the battle does not make them victims.
Dies at the Hollywoodland sign, not on the Observatory grounds. The sign destruction is an effects sequence; no qualifying real-site death pin is inferred.
Airborne deaths take place after the airship leaves the Observatory. Its moving position and exact final crew complement are not established, so no ground pin or invented full-crew total is assigned.

screenplay_caution: Twenty commandos materialize, but the same draft explicitly describes people falling wounded or dead. Do not equate attacker strength with confirmed fatalities.
media_review: The 00:25.35 frame was visually reviewed. It depicts the forecourt gunfight and is spoiler-protected; the safe facade photograph is retained.
